notes: Reviewed directly against the exact served source photographs identified by SHA-256, without browser UI.
Rectangles include neighboring pixels to inspect boundaries; these are diagnostic regions, not semantic masks.
Overlapping regions are evaluated independently. Confidence describes region identification, not recovered geometry.
Preserve full-image framing. Rasterize left/top with floor and right/bottom with ceil, using an exclusive right/bottom pixel boundary.
